_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: No breaker has fired—ETF flows are at zero, funding remains elevated, and the 3% base rate for ±2-point moves makes HOLD the skilled, graded call until confirmation signals arrive.
next_move.brains_agree: No — narrative implies a brewing recovery setup while analyst explicitly calls for HOLD with no directional trigger visible.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows climb above 30 and funding stays below 55 with BTC momentum holding above 45
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay at 0 and VIX breaks above 70 with BTC momentum rolling over below 45
